description: This Java source file defines a custom annotation @HonoTimestamp used for marking fields of type Instant for custom JSON serialization and deserialization in ISO-8601 extended offset date-time format. It includes associated serializer and deserializer classes to handle conversion between Instant objects and ISO-8601 formatted strings.

classes.name: Deserializer
classes.description: A Jackson deserializer for strings in ISO 8601 extended offset date-time format, converting to Instant.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A Jackson serializer that converts Instant objects into ISO 8601 formatted date-time strings.

methods.name: _deserialize
methods.description: Converts an ISO-8601 offset date-time string into an Instant object, normalizing to UTC.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an Instant into an ISO 8601 string in UTC.
